dedupe_keys.name: harmonized annual averaged traffic data at street segment level for european cities

description: Harmonized Annual Averaged Traffic Data at Street Segment Level for European Cities is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Xavier Bonnemaizon et al. Traffic flow data in Europe are collected locally by city authorities using different systems and standards, making it difficult to compare cities or evaluate large-scale maps, such as those used for emission inventories. Coverage: continental; published in 2025. Formats: GeoJSON, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
